 Follow KPop Demon Hunters’ HUNTR/X World Tour Announces Dates
 Hannah Abraham, Contributor Updated Fri, November 13, 2026 at 9:05 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Official poster for the world tour 
 Netflix Netflix and AEG Presents have scheduled 61 arena performances for the KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour . 
The first dates span 35 cities across North America and Europe, from June 5, 2027, in Baltimore to Oct. 23 at London's O2. Tickets go on sale to the public Nov. 20 at 10 a.m. local time.
 KPop Demon Hunters World Tour Dates And Ticket Timeline
 By a count of the published schedule, 19 North American cities account for 34 of the shows. Los Angeles has three performances at Crypto.com Arena on July 30-31, and Hamilton, Ontario, is the only Canadian city listed. The European leg opens Sept. 1 in Zurich and moves through cities including Milan, Berlin, Paris and Dublin before reaching the U.K., where there will be seven arena performances across Glasgow, Birmingham, Manchester and London.
 Mastercard cardholders get a presale Nov. 18, followed by a "FOR THE FANS" presale Nov. 19, according to the announcement. Tourwide ticket prices haven't been announced yet. VIP packages will include reserved seats, on-stage photo opportunities and preshow parties.
 Who Will Perform At The KPop Demon Hunters Concert?
 The announcement describes a show in which animated characters, including HUNTR/X members Rumi, Mira and Zoey, the Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger, interact with the audience through new performance technology. Live performers and stunts appear alongside them. It does not say whether EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami, who sing for the trio, will take part, or whether it will be different performers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement That was also the case in May, when Netflix first revealed the tour at its Upfront presentation.
 Most Planned KPop Demon Hunters Tour Dates Are Still Unscheduled
 Organizers say the tour will reach nearly 50 cities and stage more than 150 performances across 2027 and 2028. The 61 announced shows cover about two-fifths of that total. Asia Pacific and Latin America dates are "coming soon," according to the announcement, with no stops in either region on the published schedule.
 How KPop Demon Hunters Became A Touring Franchise
 Netflix says the film, released June 2025, is its most-watched ever, with more than 670 million views, and that it has spent 63 consecutive weeks in the platform's Global Top 10. In a statement, Netflix chief marketing officer Marian Lee said the fandom "was never about a single moment," describing the tour as a way to extend it. AEG Presents' Rich Schaefer said the production would keep the music at its center and make fans part of the experience.
 KPop Demon Hunters won Best Animated Feature and "Golden" won Best Original Song at the Oscars on March 15, making "Golden" the first K-pop song to win that award. It had already won the Grammy for best song written for visual media, a first for a K-pop song. The soundtrack was the first to place four songs in the Billboard Hot 100's top 10 simultaneously.
